pages.text: $(bold)Origin Magic$() (comes with Origin Alloy, $(bold)leveled$())$(br2)$(bold)Only the single highest-level piece applies$() (it does not stack):$(li)$(bold)all spells you cast get +2 x level levels$() (unlike Arcane Conduction, which only boosts spells inscribed in the item, this applies to every spell)$(li)$(bold)unlearned eldritch spells can be used without learning$() (eldritch = Iron's Spells' eldritch school; their tooltips are no longer scrambled either)$(br2)$(italic)The first magic never needed permission.$()
